backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (Lead, Service, Project, Payment, etc.), application roles (Admin/Manager/Client/Demo), and state management with Maps for leads, services, deals, projects, payments, and user profiles, integrating AccessControl and Storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five analytics features (revenue trends chart, service categories chart, top performers chart, data computation utilities, and AnalyticsPage layout update) with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of frontend files including hooks for data management with RBAC guards, pages with role-based access, UI components, and authentication flows using AppRole enum and demo mode support.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI elements (background, foreground, primary, secondary, charts, sidebar) using OKLCH color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Quick Bee AI Growth Engine application with favicon reference and script tag loading the React app from main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router configuration defining application routes with role-based access control using RequireRole wrapper, AuthGate for authentication, and AppShell layout for protected routes.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminOnlyS: Empty file placeholder for admin-only UI section component.
frontend/src/components/admin/ClientServ: Empty file placeholder for admin panel to manage client service requests.
frontend/src/components/analytics/Revenu: Revenue trends line chart component using Recharts library, fetching payment data via useGetAllPayments hook and computing trends with computeRevenueTrends utility, displaying loading/error states and formatted revenue over time.
frontend/src/components/analytics/Servic: Displays a pie chart of service categories with revenue data, using Recharts and fetching analytics via useGetAgencyAnalytics hook. Shows loading, error, and empty states with color-coded category segments.
frontend/src/components/analytics/TopPer: Renders a horizontal bar chart showing top-performing services by revenue using Recharts. Fetches data via useGetAgencyAnalytics and displays loading, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthGate.ts: Guards routes by checking Internet Identity authentication or demo session status, redirecting to login if unauthorized. Shows loading spinner during initialization.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for new users to complete profile setup with name, email, mobile, agency, and role fields. Prefills email/mobile from stored sign-in identifier and calls registerUser mutation on submit.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireRole: Role-based access control component that checks user role against allowed roles, restricting demo users to specific paths. Shows access denied card with required roles if unauthorized.
frontend/src/components/common/BlockedSt: Reusable card component displaying a blocked state with warning icon, title, message, and optional action button. Used for feature restrictions or access limitations.
frontend/src/components/common/ChartBloc: Wrapper component for chart displays with consistent card styling, title header, and optional action button. Provides standardized layout for analytics charts.
frontend/src/components/common/ErrorStat: Displays error states in a card with alert icon, customizable title/message, and optional retry button. Used for graceful error handling in UI.
Card component displaying lead summary with status badge, niche icon, location, revenue potential, and owner. Includes button to open detailed lead dialog.
frontend/src/components/common/ProgressB: Progress bar component with optional label and percentage display, calculating percentage from value/max ratio. Shows formatted value counts when percentage is hidden.
frontend/src/components/common/SafeImage: Image component with error handling that displays initials fallback on load failure. Shows loading skeleton during image load.
frontend/src/components/common/ServiceNi: Renders 3D icons for services or niches using SafeImage with fallback to default icon. Generates initials-based fallback text from service/niche name.
frontend/src/components/common/StatsCard: A reusable card component that displays a statistic with optional icon, subtitle, and trend indicator showing percentage change from last month.
frontend/src/components/deals/DealCard.t: Displays a deal summary card with ID, status badge, value in INR currency format, and associated lead ID with hover effects.
frontend/src/components/deals/DealDialog: A dialog form for creating new deals with fields for value and status selection, using the useCreateDeal hook to persist data.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportDat: Provides UI for exporting application data in multiple formats (CSV, Excel, PDF, DOCX/RTF) with download functionality and loading states.
Main application layout with responsive sidebar navigation, mobile menu toggle, demo mode badge, and content container with proper spacing.
frontend/src/components/leads/AddLeadDia: Dialog form for adding new leads with fields for name, contact, city, niche, status, revenue potential, and owner using the useAddLead hook.
frontend/src/components/leads/ImportLead: Dialog for bulk importing leads from CSV files with validation, error reporting, and success/failure statistics display.
frontend/src/components/leads/LeadDetail: Dialog component for viewing and editing lead details, including contact info, revenue potential, and status updates with a dropdown selector for status changes.
frontend/src/components/nav/FollowUpBadg: Navigation badge component that displays a bell icon with a count of follow-ups due today in a popover, though the follow-up date tracking is currently a placeholder.
frontend/src/components/nav/SidebarNav.t: Main sidebar navigation component that renders role-based menu items, displays user authentication status, demo mode badge, and handles session logout with role-based access control filtering.
frontend/src/components/outreach/StartOu: Dialog form for recording outreach activities to leads, capturing platform, message content, and automatically setting a 7-day follow-up date.
frontend/src/components/payments/Checkou: Checkout dialog component that displays order summary, allows payment method selection (UPI, Razorpay, Stripe), creates payment orders, and provides payment instructions with auto-scrolling behavior.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Component that displays a list of user payment orders with service details, status badges, and admin-only status update functionality using a dropdown selector.
frontend/src/components/planner/PlannerP: Displays a 30-day planner plan with summary cards showing overall progress, current streak, and days remaining, plus a list of daily tasks with completion status and targets for leads and outreach.
frontend/src/components/projects/Project: Dialog component for viewing and updating project details including notes, completion progress, milestones, and file attachments with upload/removal capabilities.
Dialog form for creating or editing projects, allowing selection of service and client (lead), with fields for notes and status.
frontend/src/components/services/Service: Read-only dialog displaying comprehensive service details including price, delivery time, service type/niche badges, deliverables, requirements, and supported providers with optional checkout action.
Form dialog for creating or editing services with fields for name, price, delivery time, descriptions, deliverables, requirements, and supported providers (parsed as comma-separated lists).
frontend/src/components/uploads/Attachme: Displays a list of file attachments (ExternalBlob) with preview for images, download functionality, and optional remove action for each file.
React component for uploading multiple files with validation, progress tracking, and file preview. Converts files to ExternalBlob format and passes them to a callback handler.
frontend/src/constants/uploadedImages.ts: Centralized mapping of static image asset URLs (logos, icons, illustrations) using base-path aware URL generation for production compatibility.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that manages the backend actor instance with authentication, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAgencyAnalytics.ts: React Query hook that fetches aggregated analytics data (leads, deals, outreach, services, projects) from the backend, with graceful fallbacks for missing data.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthRole.ts: React Query hooks for fetching the current user's role and checking admin status, with graceful error handling for guest/unauthorized users.
frontend/src/hooks/useClientServiceReque: React Query hooks for creating and fetching client service requests, with filtering by agency and automatic query invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: React Query hooks for fetching, saving, and registering user profiles with automatic query invalidation and identity-based enablement.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeals.ts: React Query hooks for managing deals (fetch, create, update status) with role-based access control and demo mode restrictions. Backend implementation is incomplete.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebouncedValue.ts: React hook that returns a debounced version of a value, delaying updates by a specified delay (default 300ms).
frontend/src/hooks/useDemoSession.ts: React hook for managing demo session state, syncing between local storage and backend, with methods to start and end demo sessions.
frontend/src/hooks/useExportData.ts: React Query hook that fetches all exportable data (leads, deals, outreach, services, projects) from the backend for data export functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useLeads.ts: Exports React Query hooks for CRUD operations on leads (fetch, create, update, import) with role-based access control for managers/admins and demo mode restrictions.
frontend/src/hooks/useOutreach.ts: Provides React Query hooks for outreach activity management with role-based access control; backend implementation is incomplete (returns empty arrays and console warnings).
frontend/src/hooks/usePayments.ts: Provides React Query hooks for payment operations including creating payments, fetching user/all payments, updating payment status, and retrieving payment settings.
frontend/src/hooks/usePaymentSettings.ts: Exports hooks to fetch and update payment settings with admin-only access control and demo mode restrictions.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlanner.ts: Implements a 30-day task planner with in-memory storage for tracking daily lead and outreach targets/completions; includes hooks to create plans and update tasks.
frontend/src/hooks/useProjects.ts: Exports React Query hooks for project CRUD operations filtered by agency, with role-based access control (client or higher for read, manager/admin for write) and demo mode restrictions.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides a single React Query hook to fetch the current user's role from the backend actor with error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useServices.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing services: fetching all services, adding new services, updating service status, and seeding multiple services with admin role and demo mode checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionAppRole.ts: Custom hook that manages the user's selected app role in session storage, providing methods to get, set, and clear the role with state synchronization.
frontend/src/hooks/useSettings.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and updating application settings with admin role validation and demo mode restrictions.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes using OKLCH color space, including teal-green gradient utilities and reusable component classes for typography, cards, and focus states.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient provider and InternetIdentity provider wrapping the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AnalyticsPage.tsx: Displays comprehensive business analytics including revenue metrics, close rates, deal statistics, and multiple charts showing revenue by service, niche distribution, and performance trends.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard page showing agency performance overview with stats cards, charts for outreach platforms, conversion funnel, and an empty state with welcome image when no leads exist.
frontend/src/pages/DealsPage.tsx: Displays deals organized in a kanban-style board by status (Open, Proposal Sent, Won, Lost) with ability to add new deals and shows deal cards for each status column.
frontend/src/pages/LeadsPage.tsx: Displays a paginated, filterable list of leads with search, status, and niche filters. Includes an add lead dialog and uses debounced search for performance.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Provides authentication via Internet Identity or demo mode with role selection. Redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/OutreachPage.tsx: Multi-channel outreach tracking page with tabs for email, WhatsApp, call, and LinkedIn platforms. Displays outreach activities filtered by selected platform.
frontend/src/pages/PlannerPage.tsx: 30-day planner page for tracking a 3000 outreach goal. Shows plan view if exists, otherwise displays onboarding cards with a button to create a new plan.
frontend/src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx: Displays a grid of client projects with progress tracking, status badges, and file attachments. Includes dialogs for creating and viewing project details.
frontend/src/pages/ProposalSharePage.tsx: Public proposal sharing page that displays a placeholder message indicating proposal viewing is not yet implemented.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: Main services catalog page with CRUD operations, search/filter, status toggle, checkout integration, and one-time catalog seeding from predefined templates.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPricingPage.t: Static pricing page displaying hardcoded service packages (websites, WhatsApp automation, lead generation, personal branding) with checkout dialog integration.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Tabbed settings page for managing user profile, payment settings (UPI/Razorpay/Stripe), and viewing payment history with admin-specific features.
frontend/src/pages/SignInPage.tsx: Optional sign-in page that collects email/mobile identifier before redirecting to Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/pages/UnauthorizedPage.tsx: Access denied page shown when users lack required role permissions, with navigation back to dashboard.
frontend/src/types/docx.d.ts: TypeScript declarations for the 'docx' library covering document creation, paragraphs, tables, styling, borders, and export functionality.
frontend/src/types/jspdf-autotable.d.ts: TypeScript declarations for jsPDF autoTable plugin defining table options, cell definitions, styling, and callbacks.
frontend/src/types/jspdf.d.ts: TypeScript declarations for jsPDF library covering PDF creation, text rendering, formatting, page management, and output methods.
frontend/src/types/local.ts: Local type definitions for Deal and OutreachActivity entities not exported from the backend canister.
frontend/src/types/xlsx.d.ts: TypeScript type declarations for the 'xlsx' library, defining interfaces for workbooks, worksheets, and utility functions for reading/writing Excel files.
frontend/src/utils/adminAllowlist.ts: Empty file, likely a placeholder for admin user allowlist functionality.
frontend/src/utils/analytics/computeReve: Computes daily revenue trends from payment data by filtering paid payments, grouping by date, and returning sorted time-series data for the last 30 days.
frontend/src/utils/analytics/computeServ: Aggregates services by niche/category, computing count and total revenue per category, returning results sorted by revenue descending.
frontend/src/utils/analytics/computeTopP: Identifies and returns the top 10 services ranked by revenue for performance analysis.
frontend/src/utils/assets/publicAssetUrl: Generates base-path aware URLs for static assets from the public directory, handling both development and production deployments with non-root base paths.
frontend/src/utils/export/download.ts: Utility function to trigger browser download of a Blob by creating a temporary anchor element and cleaning up the object URL afterward.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportCsv.ts: Generates CSV export files with multiple sections (leads, outreach, services, deals, projects), handling CSV escaping and formatting using shared field schemas.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportDocx.ts: Generates RTF documents (openable in Word) from export data, creating formatted sections with tables for each data type without external dependencies.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportPdf.ts: Creates print-ready HTML documents styled for PDF export via browser print functionality, with formatted tables for all data sections.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportSchema.t: Defines export field schemas and formatters for all data types (leads, outreach, services, deals, projects), specifying labels and custom formatting functions.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportXlsx.ts: Generates Excel-compatible SpreadsheetML (XML) files without external dependencies, creating worksheets with styled headers for each data type.
frontend/src/utils/export/filename.ts: Generates timestamped filenames for exports and formats human-readable timestamps for display in exported documents.
frontend/src/utils/icons/serviceNiche3dI: Maps service types/subtypes and niche values to 3D icon asset URLs, providing fallback defaults and helper functions for retrieving appropriate icons.
frontend/src/utils/leads/csv.ts: Parses CSV text into Lead objects, validating required columns (name, contact, city, niche) and returning both successfully parsed leads and any parsing errors.
frontend/src/utils/rbac.ts: Defines role-based access control (RBAC) logic with route permissions for Admin, Manager, and Client roles, plus demo mode restrictions and helper functions for checking access rights.
Exports a predefined catalog of services across three categories (Website & Funnel, AI & Automation, Marketing & Growth) with pricing and delivery time information.
frontend/src/utils/services/serviceDetai: Provides utility functions to parse newline-separated strings into arrays and vice versa, used for managing service detail fields like deliverables and requirements.
frontend/src/utils/sessionAuth.ts: Manages session-based authentication state in sessionStorage, storing and retrieving user role (AppRole) and demo session flags.
frontend/src/utils/signInIdentifier.ts: Handles sign-in identifier storage and classification (email vs phone), with normalization and matching logic for user authentication flows.
frontend/src/utils/uploads/fileValidatio: Validates uploaded files against allowed types (images, PDFs, documents, spreadsheets) and enforces a 10MB size limit.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Extracts and manages URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup utilities.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH, container settings, extended theme properties, and plugins for animations, typography, and container queries.
project_state.json: Project state file for QUICK BEE AGENCY Business Management SaaS with Firebase backend, 3D-style UI, and analytics features. Tracks 5 existing features (revenue trends, service categories, top performers charts) and 2 pending feature requests for analytics dashboard and charting library integration.
